adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` now compute the fallback calendar id as:

```ts
externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else-branch), the predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null`, so it will not match any normal destination calendar (whose `externalId` is a string). This makes the fallback resolve to `undefined` instead of selecting a destination calendar, which can prevent correct deletion/updating for bookings that rely on `event.destinationCalendar` rather than an explicit `externalCalendarId`.
